_meta.source: 按游戏数据手工整理: official GGG CDN table export (pathofexile-dat 15.2.0, dat-schema v7), not vendor totemLifeMult.

MonsterTypes.note: MonsterVarieties.MonsterType -> MonsterTypes row: Totem, BallistaTotem, AncestorTotem, SpellTotem, GrenadeTotem have Armour 100; ShockwaveTotem and DarkEffigyTotem 0; every totem type has Evasion 0 and EnergyShieldFromLife 0.

MinionGemLevelScaling.note: GemLevel 1..40 -> MinionLevel 2..80 (2 x gem level); equal to pobr-core calc::minion::MINION_LEVEL_TABLE.

_meta.selection: One row per totem-summoning granted effect: ActiveSkills.SkillTotemId -> SkillTotemVariations row with TotemSkinId 0 -> MonsterVarieties. Skins (Vampiric, Verisium, ...) share the skin-0 LifeMultiplier in this export. SkillTotemId 27 is the default for non-totem skills and has no variation. summon_meta_totem_axes (SkillTotemId 20) has no variation row and no player granted effect.
_meta.units: life_multiplier is MonsterVarieties.LifeMultiplier in percent (100 = 1x). armour / evasion are MonsterTypes.Armour / Evasion, percent of the level's DefaultMonsterStats.Armour / Evasion; energy_shield_from_life is MonsterTypes.EnergyShieldFromLife, percent of maximum Life. Base resistances come from base/monster_resistances.json for monster_variety (all totem varieties are 0 in this patch).
_meta.notes: Once the adapter exports these columns, it should generate this file. Re-audit on patch updates.
